ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_APPEARANCE.Note: Everything that has to do with the actual body appearance of the raider

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_STYLE.Note: Everything that has to do with how you style the body, i.e. skins, backpacks, etc.

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES.Note: Emotes that the raider will be able to customize on the emote wheel

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES_SUBNAV.Note: Sub-nav tab to navigate to Emotes

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES_EMOTEWHEEL.Note: General noun for the emote wheel used in a few places

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES_EQUIPTOWHEEL.Note: Button allowing the player to equip the emote

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES_RESETWHEEL.Note: Button allowing the player to reset the wheel to default choices

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES_ADDWHEEL.Note: Allows the player to add a new wheel

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES_NOEDIT.Note: Informs the player that some wheel options are set and can't be changed

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_COSMETIC_LOCKED_MESSA.Note: To signal that a cosmetic is locked by a condition

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_COSMETIC_LOCKED_BY_QU.Note: To signal that a cosmetic is locked by a quest

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_COSMETIC_LOCKED_BY_LE.Note: To signal that a cosmetic is locked by a level

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_COSMETIC_LOCKED_BY_DE.Note: To signal that a cosmetic is locked by a decks

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_COSMETIC_LOCKED_BY_EV.Note: To signal that a cosmetic is locked by a event

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_COSMETIC_LOCKED_BY_TR.Note: To signal that a cosmetic is locked by a trials

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_COSMETIC_LOCKED_BY_EX.Note: To signal that a cosmetic is locked by a expedition

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_COSMETIC_LOCKED_MESSA.Note: To signal that a cosmetic will be unlocked by something

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES_EQUIPTOWHEEL_F.Note: Tells the player that this is a non-changeable, non-negotiable emote in the emote wheel (see here)

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_SKINPROGRESSION_QUEST.Note: Unlock condition: Quest rewards (meaning you already have this quest available)
Unlock condition: future quest reward (not yet available to you)

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_SKINPROGRESSION_LEVEL.Note: Exact level of the above unlock condition

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_SKINPROGRESSION_LIVEE.Note: Unlock condition: live event reward (Already available to you)

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_SKINPROGRESSION_LEVEL.Note: Unlock condition: future live event reward (not yet available to you)

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_SKINPROGRESSION_RAIDE.Note: Unlock condition: Raider project reward (already available)
Unlock condition: raider project reward (not yet available to you)

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_ALL_HEADGEAR_VISIBLE.Note: Show how to hide all currently equipped headgear

ID_CHARACTERSCREEN_EMOTES_EQUIPTOWHEEL_U.Note: Informs the player some emotes cannot be changed/overridden
